description: A C# game engine in which a program opens a window, draws each frame with plain static calls named as raylib's functions are, and draws Dear ImGui in the same frame, over SDL3, Vulkan and Slang, with an ECS and source-generated behaviors underneath.
releaseNotes:
DESIGN.md, the README and a guide page of its own say the loop and the ECS are both the engine's way, each where it fits, with the voxel game as the model of the split.
Sentences joined by a colon in the guides, the readings and the comments of the engine, the tests, the examples, the games and the scripts are recast as STYLE.md says.
A program keeps a TextEdit that EditText updates from each frame's typing, with a caret, a selection, the clipboard and Tab between edits, and DrawTextEdit draws it in a plain look.
A ray of global illumination crossing a canopy's leaves is shaded twice at most, the first leaf it crosses standing for all of them, and gi.toggle through reads what the crossing costs.
title: 3DEngine
